title.value: Lag-Llama: Towards Foundation Models for Time Series Forecasting
title.justification: The paper introduces 'Lag-Llama,' a foundation model for time-series forecasting.
title.quote: ...we present here our work-in-progress on Lag-Llama, a general-purpose univariate probabilistic time-series forecasting model trained on a large collection of time-series data.

extractions.description: The paper presents the development of Lag-Llama, a foundation model aimed at enhancing time-series forecasting through training on a large corpus of diverse time-series data, thereby pushing the boundaries of generalization and zero-shot prediction capabilities in out-of-distribution settings.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper's central theme is the development of a foundation model for time-series forecasting, which serves various domains like finance and weather, but does not specifically focus on climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Probabilistic time-series forecasting is an important practical problem arising in a wide range of applications, from finance and weather forecasting to brain imaging and computer systems performance management [32].

primary_category.justification: The paper does not emphasize climate or ecological sustainable development but rather focuses on improving general-purpose time-series forecasting models.
primary_category.quote: we present here our work-in-progress on Lag-Llama, a general-purpose univariate probabilistic time-series forecasting model trained on a large collection of time-series data.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper primarily addresses time-series forecasting without an explicit focus on secondary climate or ecological applications.
secondary_categories.quote: ...Aiming to build foundation models for time-series forecasting and study their scaling behavior...

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not align with specific sub-categories relevant to climate or ecological sustainable development.
primary_sub_category.quote: ...we present here our work-in-progress on Lag-Llama, a general-purpose univariate probabilistic time-series forecasting model trained on a large collection of time-series data.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No indication in the paper suggests relevance to any other sub-category under climate or ecological sustainable development.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Various methods have been proposed for this task, ranging from classical autoregressive models [19] to the more recent neural forecasting methods based on deep learning architectures [44].

applications.justification: Weather forecasting is mentioned as a potential application of the time-series forecasting model discussed in the paper.
applications.quote: Probabilistic time-series forecasting is an important practical problem arising in a wide range of applications, from finance and weather forecasting to brain imaging and computer systems performance management [32].

new_primary_category.justification: The paper is essentially about improving time-series forecasting models, which is generally applicable across domains, including but not only limited to climate and ecological forecasting.
new_primary_category.quote: ...we aim to develop foundation models for time-series, investigate their behavior at scale, and push the limits of transfer achievable across diverse time-series domains.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: This suggests a new sub-category for papers that focus on building foundational models that enhance the capability of time-series forecasting across different domains.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: ...an important practical problem arising in a wide range of applications, from finance and weather forecasting to brain imaging and computer systems performance management [32].
